summary: Serves published Google Slides with background elements (#abcdef) removed for transparent video overlay.

ports.name: Trigger
ports.text: Executes request handling when connected to HttpFileServer's 'On HTTP Request'.

ports.name: Request Data
ports.text: Request object from HttpFileServer ('HTTP Request Data') containing query parameters and pathname.

ports.name: Response
ports.text: HTTP ServerResponse object from HttpFileServer ('HTTP Response Data').

ports.name: Target Background Color
ports.text: Background hex color formatted in Google Slides to remove (default: '#abcdef').

ports.name: Hide Viewer Navbar
ports.text: If true, hides the bottom Google Slides presentation controls.

ports.name: Fetch URL Direct
ports.text: Optional direct URL or local path to transform independently of incoming HTTP requests.

ports.name: Trigger Direct Fetch
ports.text: Manually triggers fetching and transforming 'Fetch URL Direct'.

ports.name: On Success
ports.text: Fired when slides HTML has been transformed and served.

ports.name: On Error
ports.text: Fired when fetching or transformation encounters an error.

ports.name: Transformed HTML
ports.text: The resulting HTML document string with transparent backgrounds and injected observer scripts.

ports.name: Last Slide URL
ports.text: The URL or path of the last requested/transformed presentation.

ports.name: Error
ports.text: Error message if request processing failed.
